name: modeler-suite
description: Claude Code plugins of the Miragon modeler suite: the method and file-format skills of the Wardley Maps, Event Storming, Team Topologies and Business Model Canvas modelers, and the new-modeler skill for building a modeler on @miragon/modeler-api and @miragon/modeler-shell.

plugins.name: modeler-kit
plugins.description: The new-modeler skill: build a Miragon modeler end to end from a runnable template, on @miragon/modeler-api and @miragon/modeler-shell.

plugins.name: wardley-maps-modeler
plugins.description: Wardley Mapping for Claude: the method (value chains, evolution, doctrine, gameplay, creating maps, map reviews with colour-coded feedback notes) plus the complete OWM text DSL (grammar, coordinates and layout, diagnostics, round-trip). Lets Claude read, write, review and generate Wardley Maps as plain text.

plugins.name: event-storming-modeler
plugins.description: Event Storming for Claude: the method (sticky grammar, the three workshop levels, board reviews with colour-coded feedback) plus the complete `.storm` text DSL: grammar, layout, diagnostics, round-trip. Lets Claude read, write, review and generate Event Storming boards as plain text.

plugins.name: team-topologies-modeler
plugins.description: Team Topologies for Claude: team types, interaction modes and topology reviews, plus the complete `.tt` / `.ttm.json` format with a layout grid and a dependency-free checker. Lets Claude design, draw, review and edit Team Topologies diagrams as plain JSON.

plugins.name: business-model-canvas-modeler
plugins.description: The Business Model Canvas for Claude: the method (the nine building blocks, tape colours a team gives meaning to, assumptions to test, canvas reviews with feedback notes) plus the complete `.bmc` file format: YAML with the canvas fields, blocks, sticky keys, notes, diagnostics, round-trip. Lets Claude read, write, review and generate business model canvases as plain text.
